topic: Design the best-in-class remote-control experience for the Pi coding agent: a private mobile client pairing with Pi like Claude Code + Claude mobile but exceeding it, without abandoning loopback-relay / tailnet-only / foreground-authority / redaction posture. 8 experience axes: (1) live transcript richness; (2) low-friction phone approval with exact-action binding; (3) actionable notification-as-pull via bounded needs_input/finished/error attention class resolving content-free-push contradiction; (4) scoped accept-edits/session allow-list bound to lease/CAS; (5) browsable renamable session list under opaque-id/redaction; (6) background sessions and starting new work while away; (7) onboarding/pairing simpler than Tailscale+ticket; (8) single-host multi-session concurrency.

noveltyJustification: First pass; establishes competitive baseline (Claude Code Remote Control, Copilot Mobile, Cursor iOS, Codex remote, Devin) and the 041 constraint map; all findings new.
Consolidates stream-json/Messages-API/OpenCode vocabularies; the transcript.* kind vocabulary + redaction projection + PWA rendering mapping are new design output.
Pi --mode rpc native vocabulary (thinking deltas, queue_update attention signal, tool_execution_*) is new and load-bearing; LSP-range diff mapping and per-turn usage events are new design.

focus: Axis 2: low-friction phone approval with exact-action binding
noveltyJustification: Approval event schema, tiered friction UX, digest-chip visibility, and lease-expiry cure for reference stall failure are new; OWASP/NIST rules consolidated.
Two-channel resolution (local encrypted cache + fetch-on-open) with opaque attentionId pointers is new; RFC 8291 4KB physics and iOS visible-notification rule reframe the contradiction.

focus: Axis 4: scoped accept-edits / session allow-list bound to lease/CAS
noveltyJustification: Policy-backed leases (allow-list as audited decider inside the CAS ledger) are new; Claude Code modes and sudo timestamp vocabulary consolidated.
Two-layer identity (server-opaque key + per-device label map, ciphertext-only optional sync) is new; tmux/Tailscale/Claude Code prior art consolidated.

focus: Axis 6: background sessions + starting new work while away
noveltyJustification: Park-on-needs_input semantics, supervision events, registered-workspace session.create are new; bypass rejection and systemd model consolidated.
Single-QR compression (tailnet join URL + pairing nonce; device credential replacing bootstrap ticket) is new; Tailscale/Signal prior art + T1676 defenses consolidated.
Workspace write leases, per-session fault isolation, cross-session approval/budget governance are new; CC capacity, tmux isolation honesty, OpenCode lifecycle consolidated.
Reconciliation table + 3 new gaps (machine-enforced redaction classes, lock-state-aware notifications, Serve-proxy validation); Serve/lock-screen citations new.
Single buildable schema artifact (envelope + 25-kind union + payload shapes + redaction classes + push payload) consolidating iterations 2-11.
Research-preview status, two-toggle notification surface, conversation-vs-session naming distinction, tag-semantics validation; small load-bearing design deltas.

focus: Platform audit: iOS/Android PWA notification + background constraints
noveltyJustification: Three-path SW notification handling, cache-as-cache doctrine, pairing-anchored permission timing; platform mechanics consolidated.
Glance actions as lease-CAS decision submissions with risk-class bounds and iOS action-button limitation row are new; platform mechanics consolidated.

focus: Session catalog redaction, retention, offline cache
noveltyJustification: Complete catalog field list, retention tier table, AES-GCM cache spec with memory-only key discipline; platform facts cited.
Fence/expiry/CAS edge table + 'offline displays never decides' rule; fencing/ledger prior art cited.

focus: Gap check: transcript search/navigation + cost guard
noveltyJustification: Seq-anchored search/bookmarks + local-forecast cost guard mapped onto parking; reference open issues as roadmap.

focus: Gap check 2: waiting affordance, error attention, fallback surface
noveltyJustification: Waiting-bar affordance, recovery card mapping native auto_retry events, browser-fallback row; reference failure + recovery patterns cited.

focus: Final breadth: pairing depth + coverage audit + convergence telemetry
noveltyJustification: Pairing auth-key mechanics completion, 8/8 axis coverage audit, saturation telemetry (last-5 mean 0.44); loop reached 20-iteration cap.
